headline: Linn Mercy Flares as Expanse Fight Continues
war_summary: Since the last edition the centre has moved to Linn Mercy, which posts seven flips in two hours and thirty-four on the day about Outwich Ranch, Rotdust and Lathair, now listing one Warden, nine Colonial and one ruined post with 3,481 Colonial and 6,156 Warden casualties in twenty-four hours. The Weathered Expanse holds close with six in two hours and thirty on the day about Crow's Nest, Spirit Watch and Huntsfort, now five Warden, two Colonial and two ruined with 5,757 and 6,021 losses. Callum's Cape cools to two in two hours though forty-eight on the day about Naofa, Scouts Jest and Ire, now three Warden to four Colonial with 16,547 and 14,480 losses. Mooring County falls silent in two hours after earlier stir, still thirty-seven on the day about the Wind Hills with nine Warden to three Colonial. Marban Hollow and Lykos Isle also log none in two hours, while Callahan's Passage records no flips despite 1,580 and 1,155 losses.
